1.mascotDialogue: One edge, two entries in adjacency matrix. Forget second one, and congratulations, you quietly build half a directed graph instead.

2.mascotDialogue: Line 2 and line 3 not optional extra of each other — same conceptual edge, must add together, as one pair, every single time.

3.mascotDialogue: No arrowhead this time — just plain line, because connection mutual by nature.

4.mascotDialogue: Visual show single arrowhead where undirected graph should never have one at all — that mismatch the bug, quite hard to miss.
